## Change

Describe the behavior being added, changed, or removed.

## Specification impact

- [ ] No protocol-visible behavior changes.
- [ ] The normative specification, schema, or ADR is updated first.
- [ ] Compatibility impact is documented.

## Verification

- [ ] Accepted and rejected cases are tested.
- [ ] `python scripts/verify_repository.py` passes.
- [ ] Relevant Python, Node, adapter, packaging, or Docker checks pass.
- [ ] No real-pilot claim relies on synthetic evidence.

## Security and privacy

State any change to identity, authorization, trust, secrets, network access,
stored content, retention, or failure behavior. Write `None` only after review.
